fixed_field.proper_subfields: Their dlog vectors on the 16 aligned lifts to the fixed field sum to zero in F8: translation by a nonzero involution pairs equal entries. This also holds for products from any of these proper subfields.

scope: The degree-16 primitive search is bounded. Only the cancellation for proper subfields of this fixed field is universal.

search.criterion: Integral at all finite places; norm to F2(x) has support in x,x+1. Every point over 0,1,infinity is in T.
search.independent_control: One full-degree candidate checked by multiplication of 16 conjugates, then by a polynomial resultant.
